en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains; Saudel about 400 km east-northeast
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated near 23.1 degrees north, 118.0 degrees east early Thursday and is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea before turning westwards.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal, No. 1 remained in force early on Thursday. At about 1 a.m., Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated to be about 400 kilometres east-northeast of Hong Kong, near 23.1 degrees north and 118.0 degrees east, and was forecast to be slow-moving while lingering over the northeastern part of the South China Sea.

Saudel is expected to gradually turn westwards later on Thursday and then skirt the coast of eastern Guangdong. Under the combined effect of the storm and the northeast monsoon, local winds are occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The Observatory said the No. 1 signal would remain in force on Thursday morning.

The storm is forecast to edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary again on Friday, though there are rather large uncertainties in its intensity by then. The Observatory said it would closely monitor Saudel’s movement and assess the need to issue the Strong Wind Signal, No. 3 when the system draws nearer to the estuary. The public was advised to continue paying attention to the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾位於本港東北偏東約400公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾周四凌晨位於北緯23.1度、東經118.0度附近，預料在南海東北部徘徊後逐漸轉西，掠過廣東東部沿岸。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周四凌晨繼續生效。上午約1時，熱帶風暴沙德爾集結在香港東北偏東約400公里，即北緯23.1度、東經118.0度附近，預料移動緩慢，在南海東北部徘徊。
沙德爾稍後會逐漸轉向偏西方向移動，隨後掠過廣東東部沿岸。受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。天文台指一號戒備信號會在周四早上維持。
預料沙德爾會在周五再度靠近珠江口一帶，但屆時其強度存在相當大變數。天文台會密切監察沙德爾的動向，評估是否需要在其接近珠江口時改發三號強風信號。市民請繼續留意天文台的最新天氣消息。
